# Pranav Dhawan

> Personal portfolio of Pranav Dhawan — AI engineer, data scientist, and founder of SideQuest India. Builds production AI systems: workplace automation, document intelligence, RAG, NLP, and computer vision.

## About

- Founder, SideQuest India (July 2026 – present): a social platform for discovering plans and connecting through real-world experiences. First web experience reached 500+ users in its first 7 days.
- AI Workplace Engineer Intern, American Chemical Society, Washington, DC (May 2026 – present): AI-orchestrated service-desk workflow across Microsoft Copilot, Ivanti, and SharePoint automating roughly 245 of 350 monthly tickets; onboarding/offboarding agent; AI governance framework.
- Independent Contractor – AI, Siva Info LLC, New York, NY (June 2026 – present): edition-aware PDF-diff tooling; XML tagging pipeline taken from 32% to 99% completeness and accuracy across ~3,000 entries.
- Machine Learning Engineer, Lumina Datamatics, Chennai, India (February 2024 – August 2024): YOLOv8 document intelligence pipeline on AWS SageMaker (10,000+ documents per day); hybrid RAG system for legal document search.
- MS Data Science, George Washington University (August 2024 – May 2026, GPA 3.74/4.0). B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering, Manipal University Jaipur (August 2020 – May 2024, GPA 8.51/10.0).
- Earlier internships: HCLTech (machine learning), EY (analytics).

## Projects

- [Singularity](https://github.com/pranavdhawann/singularity): local-first memory and permission layer for AI assistants (TypeScript, RAG, SQLite FTS5, Ollama)
- [Edge-Based PII Detection & Censoring System](https://github.com/pranavdhawann/Final-Project-Group4): 98.1% F1 across 54 PII entity types with DeBERTa served via ONNX
- [Multimodal Techniques for Equity Forecasting](https://github.com/pranavdhawann/spring-2026-group4): benchmark of 10+ architectures on FinMultiTime
- [Stock Screen](https://github.com/pranavdhawann/stock-screen): real-time AI-powered market research terminal (archived)
